name: whichvideo
description: 本地视频库：导入视频/文件夹，以图搜帧，查看图片对应视频是否已下载，文件夹动态更新
author: weiningwei

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run icon && pnpm tauri build --no-bundle
scripts.build:win: npm run typecheck && npm run icon && pnpm tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.build:mac: npm run typecheck && npm run icon && pnpm tauri icon build/icon.png && pnpm tauri build --bundles app
scripts.build:linux: npm run typecheck && npm run icon && pnpm tauri build --bundles appimage
scripts.build:portable: npm run typecheck && npm run icon && pnpm tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/build-tauri-portable.mjs
scripts.build:portable:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run icon && node scripts/build-tauri-fast.mjs
scripts.test: npm run icon && npm run typecheck && npm run test:release && npm run test:rust && npm run test:contract && npm run test:portable && npm run test:theme && npm run test:cursor && npm run test:range && npm run test:path && npm run test:ui && npm run test:events
